data.one_liner: China city picker plugin supporting multi-column linkage and alphabetical index selection.
data.what_it_does: CityPickers is a Flutter plugin providing city and region selection widgets for China. It supports bottom sheet pickers, full-page pickers, and alphabetic list selectors with search functionality and customizable themes.
use_when: You need to build a location or city selection flow for Chinese addresses in a Flutter app.
You want popup or full-page multi-level cascading dropdowns for province, city, and district data.
avoid_when: Your application targets regions outside of China where standardized national statistical region codes are not applicable.
strengths: Supports multiple display modes including bottom sheet, full-page, and alphabetical selector.
Provides built-in utils to lookup area results by region codes.
Supports customizable themes, widgets, and search functionality.
weaknesses: Focused primarily on Chinese administrative divisions.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import city_pickers.dart.
